imitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one skill by URI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the
manifest, the fetched frontmatter against what the listing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial lis
ting never mentioned. When a check fails the response carries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-server-skills-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, che
cking its byte length and digest against the skill's own manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rathe
r than accepted from the caller, so a request cannot authorize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/export/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lists tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON snap
shot: handy for diffing a server's surface over time in CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-
a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `
executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls**: the server answered; only transport/a
uth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Rende
rs a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widg
et headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and m
ount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it log
ged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained w
idget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local I
nspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the o
riginal subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromiu
m context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.m
d): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API
key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility
tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on
-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a
verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs
one coordinate action with fresh project/server authorization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments re
turn 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after it
s idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created
the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, proje
ct and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List
a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per co
mmitted edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were
launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send
a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/
attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not alrea
dy there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The acc
ounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project
accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server a
ccount](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member
's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"accoun
t_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, sam
e id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account ha
s creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.
md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best
effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the
default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_na
me_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PU
T /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating
an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation
: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in
the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `max
Projects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the
mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved server in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the
host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requir
es project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's s
erver map is not updatable here. See the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived booleans, so an agent on a static su
rface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its detai
